title: CoherentFormalModuleAffineSpecTransport
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, and $V$ an affine open with Noetherian open subscheme. Put $A=\Gamma(X,V)$ and $J=I(V)$. Write coherent formal modules as in [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. There exists an equivalence $T:\mathit{Coh}(V,I|_V)\simeq\mathit{Coh}(\operatorname{Spec} A,\widetilde J)$ with a natural isomorphism of $A$-module inverse-system functors from top sections on $V$ (with scalars transported along $V.\mathrm{topIso}^{-1}$) to the Spec/global-section system functor after $T$. Here $\widetilde J$ is ofIdealTop of the image of $J$ along the inverse of the canonical Spec global-sections ring isomorphism. The natural comparison includes transition maps and every morphism of coherent formal modules; there is no completion or limit in this statement.

source.place: Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine) and Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine restriction; official tag pages read during this delivery

proof.text: Put A = Γ(X,V), e = V.2.isoSpec and K = ofIdealTop (I(V).map ΓSpecIso.inv). Apply ext_of_isAffine and ideal_top_comap_of_isAffine from the affine ideal-extension module. Rewrite e.inv.appTop by isoSpec_inv_appTop, then combine Ideal.map_map with map_topIso_ideal_top_comap_ι. This proves (I.comap V.ι).comap e.inv = K. The equality K.comap e.hom = I.comap V.ι follows from comap_comp, e.hom_inv_id and comap_id.

Apply exists_formalSystemsPullback in both directions and rewrite the transported ideals by step 1. This gives P,Q with equations for their composites with the full-subcategory inclusions. Whisker the tensor-pullback composition and identity comparisons by the inverse-system functor. The inclusion equations and Mathlib whiskeringRight_obj_comp identify the underlying composites P⋙Q and Q⋙P with identity diagrams. Lift these isomorphisms by fullyFaithfulCancelRight and construct Equivalence.mk P Q. Its functor is exactly P, so its underlying termwise tensor-pullback equation is still available.

On all module sheaves, form the equivalence with forward functor pushforward e.hom and inverse pushforward e.inv, using Mathlib pushforwardComp, pushforwardCongr and pushforwardId. Its adjunction and nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction e.inv identify tensorPullback e.inv naturally with pushforward e.hom by uniqueness of left adjoints. The top sections of this pushforward are source top sections restricted along e.hom.appTop. The equation ΓSpecIso.inv ≫ e.hom.appTop = V.topIso.inv follows from isoSpec_hom_appTop and inverse cancellation. restrictScalarsComp' yields the natural A-module comparison; naturality is equality of the underlying maps on each element. Whisker this sheaf-functor comparison by ℕᵒᵖ and by the source formal-module inclusion. Finally rewrite with the underlying equation for P from step 2. This yields a natural isomorphism of inverse-system functors, including all transition maps and formal-module morphisms.

proof_origin.based_on: Stacks 087W and 087X affine reduction; complete Lean construction using affine ideal extension, formal-system pullback, and pushforward/left-adjoint uniqueness instead of restrictAppIso.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_affine_spec_transport
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    [IsNoetherian V.1.toScheme] :
    letI : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, V.1) :=
      IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian V
    ∃ T : CoherentFormalModule V.1.toScheme (I.comap V.1.ι) ≌
      CoherentFormalModule (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, V.1)))
        (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
          ((I.ideal V).map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, V.1))).inv.hom)),
    Nonempty
      (((IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap V.1.ι)).ι ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ V.1.toScheme.Modules (ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1))).obj
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation V.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤) ⋙
              ModuleCat.restrictScalars V.1.topIso.inv.hom)) ≅
        T.functor ⋙
          (IsCoherentFormalModule (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
            ((I.ideal V).map
              (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, V.1))).inv.hom))).ι ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ
            (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(X, V.1))).Modules (ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1))).obj
              (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of Γ(X, V.1))))
